violated_contract: An alert rule whose datasource is the Cloud Monitoring datasource must use the timeSeriesList query type, not promQL. The monitoring contract forbids promQL on that datasource, and a page rule that violates it turns main red for the whole Backend unit suite.
canonical_prevention: test_no_alert_rule_uses_the_cloud_monitoring_promql_query_type in backend/tests/unit/test_daily_summary_monitoring_contract.py fails for any rule in backend/charts/monitoring/alert-rules.json whose node uses the Cloud Monitoring uid with a promQL node or model queryType. The rule must be expressed as timeSeriesList with the same metric, filter, aligner and threshold.
